note: Broadcast module overflow: when buffer hits 1000, adding one more drops floor(SLIDING_WINDOW_SIZE/2)=250 oldest via splice, then pushes new → 751 messages total. Tests need unique session IDs + afterEach cleanup to avoid state leaking between tests in the module's Map-based singletons.

cleonui-v2 auth module creates SQLite DB at import time, but authenticateWebSocket and authenticateToken are pure JWT functions that don't touch the DB — can test them by importing auth.js directly and signing tokens with the dev secret. No DB mocking needed for these exports.
